claims: Detroit Tigers games are primarily on Detroit SportsNet for the 2026 season.
Detroit SportsNet is available via cable providers Comcast, Spectrum, and DirecTV.
In-market streaming through the MLB app costs $19.99/month or $189.99/year.
Detroit SportsNet is carried by DirecTV on channel 663-3.
Detroit SportsNet is carried by Comcast/Xfinity on channel 1253.
Detroit SportsNet is carried by Spectrum on channel 436.
Detroit SportsNet is available via the MLB app to stream on mobile, web, and TV devices.
MLB.TV allows watching all out-of-market games for $149.99/season.
Select Detroit Tigers games are available on FOX, FS1, TBS, and Peacock.
Detroit SportsNet streaming service costs $19.99 monthly or $189.99 annually.
Jason Benetti and Dan Dickerson handle play-by-play.
Andy Dirks and Dan Petry are analysts.
WXYT-FM (97.1 The Ticket) is the flagship radio station.
The Tigers moved from FanDuel Sports Network (formerly Bally Sports) to Detroit SportsNet in 2026.
Detroit SportsNet is supported by MLB
